items.title: Apprentice Witch Practicing Balance
items.alt: A young witch balances a broom horizontally on both open palms.
items.description: A young apprentice witch balances a broom horizontally on both open palms while standing firmly on two feet, concentrating with a cheerful expression. Use this illustration for balance and practice stories and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch in a Leaf Boat
items.alt: A witch paddles a small curled leaf boat with a travel bundle behind her.
items.description: A witch sits safely in a curled leaf boat and holds a short wooden paddle, with a tiny travel bundle behind her; only a small isolated ripple beneath. Use this illustration for adventure story prompts and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch at an Apple Stand
items.alt: A witch places an apple on a mechanical scale beside a basket of apples.
items.description: A market witch places one apple onto a small mechanical scale while three apples sit in an open basket beside it, blank scale dial. Use this illustration for harvest counting activities and personal crafts.
